ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB=24$, $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$, point $D$ is on line segment $AC$, and $AD:CB=1:3$, then what is the length of $DB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$ and $AB=24$,\\
$\therefore$AC=CB=12,\\
Since $AD\colon CB=1\colon 3$,\\
$\therefore$AD=$\frac{1}{3}$BC=4,\\
$\therefore$DB=AB−AD=24−4=\boxed{20}.
